title: Nine Names on the List
subtitle: 候选人与应试 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 候选人与应试（社会服务与人际沟通·选举与选拔）
meta: 主题语境：候选人与应试（社会服务与人际沟通·选举与选拔）　|　核心词汇：candidate　|　正文 345 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 candidate 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1958 my mother was sent to interview ① a candidate she could not place, and she said the placing was the whole of the lesson. The ② candidate, meaning the person and not the name, was nine years younger in the file and was seen by whoever came last; a candidate, she said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ candidate in that file had the same handwriting, and the ④ candidate at the end, meaning the one the chairman kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever interviewed properly. A candidate, my grandmother said, is nine parts hope and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the hope is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ candidate was the whole of the election, meaning the contest it stood for and not the person. The ⑥ candidate, meaning the election and not any of that, is the only thing in a town that everybody votes for and nobody questions; a candidate, he said, is either someone you interview or the only word that means both a person and an election. She said the election is the part they remember.

By 1973 the ⑦ candidate had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the handwriting. The ⑧ candidate of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine names and eleven years of interviewing; a candidate, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ candidate I remember is the one at the end, which was elected in 1978 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ candidate, my grandmother said in 1983, is the only thing that improves by being questioned; every candidate, she said, is an election that has agreed to look like a person. She said the election was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 候选人；应试者
B. n. 候选人（指那个人本身，与名字相对）
C. 固定搭配：interview a candidate 面试一位候选人
D. n. 候选人（指档案里每一位）
E. n. 候选人（指末尾那一位）
F. n. 候选人（抽象：他代表的那场选举）
G. n. 那场选举（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a candidate she could not place
The candidate, meaning the person and not the name
candidate was the whole of the election
the candidate had become a number in a report
The candidate of the whole thing
A candidate, my grandmother said in 1983

answers.why: interview a candidate 意为“面试一位候选人”，1958 年母亲被派去面试一位她对不上号的候选人。
candidate 意为“候选人”，指那个人本身而不是名字，档案里小九岁，由最后走的人接见。
candidate 指档案里每一位候选人，每一位都是同样的笔迹。
candidate 指末尾那一位（主席留的那一位），是唯一有人认真面试过的。
candidate 意为“候选人”，抽象指他代表的那场选举，父亲说 candidate 就是那场选举的全部。
candidate 为抽象用法，指那场选举本身，是镇上人人都投、却没人质疑的东西。
candidate 意为“候选人、应试者”，到 1973 年这位 candidate 成了报告里的一个数字。
candidate 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九个名字和十一年的面试。
candidate 意为“候选人”，我记得的是末尾那一位，1978 年当选，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
candidate 为抽象总称，祖母说候选人是唯一会因为被追问而变好的。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1958 年母亲被派去面试一位她对不上号的候选人，她说对上号才是这堂课的全部。（interview a candidate）
那位候选人，指的是那个人本身而不是名字，档案里小九岁，由最后走的人接见。（candidate）
那份档案里每一位候选人都是同样的笔迹。（candidate）
末尾那位候选人，指的是主席留的那一位，是唯一有人认真面试过的。（candidate）
父亲说 candidate 就是那场选举的全部，指的是选举本身而不是那个人。（candidate）
1983 年祖母说，候选人是唯一会因为被追问而变好的。（candidate）
answers: In 1958 my mother was sent to interview a candidate she could not place, and she said the placing was the whole of the lesson.
The candidate, meaning the person and not the name, was nine years younger in the file and was seen by whoever came last.
Every candidate in that file had the same handwriting.
The candidate at the end, meaning the one the chairman kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever interviewed properly.
My father said candidate was the whole of the election, meaning the contest it stood for and not the person.
A candidate, my grandmother said in 1983, is the only thing that improves by being questioned.
